repairs.quote: Viktor conjures an Arcane Storm in an area for 6.5 seconds, which instantly deals (100/175/250 + (50% Ability Power)) magic damage followed by (65/105/145 + (35% Ability Power)) magic damage per second to surrounding enemies. The storm automatically follows champions it has recently damaged. Recast: Viktor can manually move the storm. Upgraded: The storm moves 25% faster. If a champion that the storm has damaged dies, the storm increases its size and its duration by 3 seconds (up to 6 times). When the storm appears it interrupts channeled Abilities. The farther the storm is from Viktor, the slower it moves.
